name: Gothenburg Museum of Art
scope: The original 1923 Gothenburg Museum of Art building above Götaplatsen, including the seven tall arches and broad stone forecourt stairs.
era: Built for the 1923 Jubilee Exhibition and formally inaugurated as the museum in 1925.

originalReview.notes: Exact Museum of Gothenburg archive JPEG labelled Public Domain Mark. Used only the extant 1923 museum portion at the right of the photograph.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
